contradictions.a: Itaq; diiugatæ quodammodo sunt adinuicem ultrices illæ. in agendo tamen quodammodo cōiugatæ.
contradictions.b: Sic illi ultores aliter ab invicem separantur, aliter tamen in actionibus suis non coniunguntur.
contradictions.why: A says the avengers are joined in action, B says they are not joined in action.
